messages.summary:
## Objective
- Replace the existing 2D game with a complete playable 3D, story-driven open-world city game featuring people, skyscrapers, a symbiote story, and cars.

## Requirements
- “Don't make it 2D. Make it a 3D, story-driven, open-world city with people and skyscrapers, and make a symbiote story. Also add cars.”
- Build now without clarification; note reasonable assumptions briefly when finished.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG (≤1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented the game as a Three.js browser experience loaded from unpkg.
- Chose a rainy neon city, four story encounters, a player-driven car, ambient traffic, pedestrians, and touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Replaced `index.html` with a responsive 3D-game HUD, story/menu overlay, and keyboard/touch controls.
- Created `game.js` with procedural city blocks and skyscrapers, pedestrians, traffic, a drivable vehicle, symbiote protagonist, hunter drones, four story encounters, dialogue, and ending.
- Added controls for movement, camera look, sprint/jump, tendril attack, interacting with characters, and entering/exiting the car.

### Active
- Validate JavaScript/runtime and gameplay in a browser; fix any issues.
- Capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `game.js` for syntax/runtime issues and run the project locally.
2. Test game start, walking, encounters, car interaction/driving, and ending.
3. Save and inspect a current JPEG screenshot, then briefly report assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Replaced game interface and Three.js entry point.
- `game.js`: New 3D gameplay, city generation, story, controls, and rendering.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no browser test or screenshot has been performed yet.
- `game.js` imports `three.module.js` from `https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js`.
- Start menu button initializes play; story progress is advanced with E near each highlighted encounter.

- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.

- Replaced `index.html` with a responsive game HUD, menu, story overlays, and keyboard/touch controls.

## Objective
- Replace the existing 2D game with a playable 3D, story-driven open-world city game featuring people, skyscrapers, a symbiote story, and cars.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- Save and inspect a JPEG no wider than 1280px after visual checks.

## Decisions
- Built a Three.js game set in a rainy neon city, with four story encounters, pedestrians, hunter drones, a drivable car, ambient traffic, and touch controls.
- Reduced rendering load by disabling antialiasing and shadows and lowering pixel ratio.

## Work State
### Completed
- Replaced `index.html` with the game HUD, menus, story overlays, and keyboard/touch controls.
- Created `game.js` with procedural city scenery, characters, story progression, combat, traffic, and vehicle driving.
- Verified all four story encounters, progression through `4 / 4`, and the ending.
- Verified pause/resume and car entry, driving, and exit.
- `node --check game.js` passed; browser gameplay checks completed without reported page errors or HTTP failures.
- Saved and inspected `screenshots/latest.jpg` at 1280×720; it shows the ending screen.

- (none)

- (none)

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game interface and controls.
- `game.js`: Rendering, gameplay, story, and interactions.
- `screenshots/latest.jpg`: Inspected 1280×720 JPEG of the ending screen.
- `.playwright/cli.config.json`: Local Playwright configuration used during browser validation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `index.html` modified; `game.js`, `.playwright/`, and `screenshots/` untracked.
- Three.js is imported from `https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js`.
